svg.title: Sidira — horizontal lockup (founder-mode)
svg.desc: Founder-mode horizontal lockup: dual-color six-blade diaphragm (Sid-blue + Avira-rose) + SIDIRA narrow uppercase in ink. Used only on the cofounder, about, press, and anniversary surfaces. Default lockup everywhere else is sidira-lockup.svg.

text.font-family: 'Söhne Schmal Halbfett', 'Archivo Narrow', 'Roboto Condensed', 'Helvetica Neue Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif
